namespace.description: optional namespace (tenant) this expectation belongs to; when set, the expectation only matches requests carrying the configured matchNamespaceHeader with this value, plus it remains isolated from other namespaces

timestamp.description: added to allow request and response log output to be used to create expectations

openAPIDefinition.title: open api or swagger request matcher

httpForward.title: host and port to forward to

httpForwardValidateAction.title: forward and validate against OpenAPI spec

dropConnection.description: drop the connection; ignored when streamError is set (streamError takes precedence)

streamError.description: reset the matched request stream with this error code (HTTP/2 RST_STREAM / HTTP/3 RESET_STREAM) instead of returning a response; HTTP/1.1 has no stream concept so this falls back to dropping the connection

matchers.description: per-incoming-frame response rules; when set, an incoming frame matching a rule triggers that rule's responses

graphqlSubscriptionFilter.description: GraphQL subscription query filter for graphql-transport-ws protocol. When set, incoming subscribe messages are AST-matched against this filter.

type.description: body-type discriminator emitted by the clients when serialising a GraphQL body; optional, and only GRAPHQL is meaningful here

stringOrJsonSchema.title: string value that can be support nottable, optional or a json schema

template.description: opt-in template rendered against the request whose output is parsed as a millisecond delay (e.g. respond more slowly for larger payloads); falls back to value/timeUnit on a non-numeric or blank result

templateType.description: template engine used to evaluate the delay template; only VELOCITY and MUSTACHE are supported

distribution.description: distribution for variable delays: UNIFORM requires min and max, LOG_NORMAL requires median and p99, GAUSSIAN requires mean and stdDev

socketAddress.title: remote address to send request to
